title: Kamishiro Rui — Appreciating That Spirit〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: On the Stage of Dazzling Light

rows.Line: Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nice work today, you guys♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, good work.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Our practices are going rather smoothly. That just leaves whether or not Tsukasa will be able to join us...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (No, he will...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (KAITO mentioned how he seems to be on the right track, so now's not the time to fret.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay, let's clean up and...

rows.Speaker: Miku's Voice
rows.Line:
<Hey! Emu, Nene, Rui♪
Anyone home?>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, it's Miku!
Lemme grab my phone!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Got it!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Already...?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Incredible! Now that's efficiency!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Wahoy♪ Thanks, Emu☆
Oh, Nene, Rui, you're both here too!>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, we are. What brings you here all of a sudden?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Oh, about that!
There's something I wanna ask you, Rui♪>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ask me?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Which is why I wanna try “looking for something in common” like Tsukasa's doing...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <For that other show you did as ambassadors, you noticed that Nene and the Little Mermaid both like to play video games, right? Is it similar to that?>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, I wanna know too!
Rui, please tell us!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, of course.
I'll explain in order.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
First, Miku's example.
About how “Nene and the Little Mermaid both like to play video games”...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Your interpretation is correct in terms of “finding something in common”.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<In terms of just that...
So it's not perfectly correct...?>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. The perfectly correct answer begins with asking, “Why do Nene and the Little Mermaid both like to play video games?”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, Nene, mind telling Miku and Emu about how you went about taking on the role of the Little Mermaid?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
What?!
You're dumping this on me...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um... I started with how this Little Mermaid was pretty shy but wanted to see something new because she was tired of seeing the same stuff every day.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay, and...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But the outside world... The world of humans is dangerous, so I figured that she'd prefer to discover new places by immersing herself in video games.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Books can provide similar enjoyment, but I thought video games would be better since you can control where you explore and what you do on adventures...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Also, you can play them for hours on end. And the more games you have, the more worlds you can effectively explore.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<That makes so much sense♪
But was any of that in the actual script?>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Ah, no, it wasn't.
But this “love of video games” gave Nene the connection she needed to become the Little Mermaid.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whoa... That's so cool, Nene.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh? Emu, you went through quite a lot to play the role of Shao, didn't you?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Shao had lost her parents to the war, but Miles took her in to become both her mentor and only family.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That show was also inspired by what your grandfather had to go through when founding Phoenix Wonderland...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You felt a strong connection in terms of protecting something that was entrusted to you by another family member, no?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I had no idea...!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <It isn't just about acting the same. It's really about being the same and filling their shoes!>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, that's perfectly correct.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
But Thorpe's a tricky one.
I mean, you and he are essentially polar opposites in terms of personalities.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That's the layer of added difficulty Tsukasa is currently facing.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hmm... Yeah, it's easy to say how we differ, but this is about finding common ground...>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Exactly.
Do you think you can handle it...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<To be honest, I'm not sure...
But I wanna give it a try!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Especially since Tsukasa's trying his best already♪>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I couldn't agree more...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Thanks for teaching me all this, Rui!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Thank you both too, Emu, Nene!
I promise to do my best!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay! Bye bye!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And she's gone like the usual storm she is.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. She and Tsukasa seem to have that in common.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah... So who do you think is gonna figure out Thorpe first? Tsukasa or Miku?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I really can't say.
This may just come down to some sort of serendipity.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Serendipity?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. A chance discovery that leads one to a profound realization.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Will our dear troupe leader be able to make such a discovery...?)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (We'll be awaiting good news, Tsukasa...)
